cases.question: What is the minimum credit score required for a home loan?

cases.question: Is there any charge for prepaying a floating rate home loan?

cases.question: Which documents can I use as proof of identity and address for KYC?
cases.answer: Proof of identity and address for KYC can be provided using any of the following documents: Aadhaar card (with masked number where required), passport, driving licence, voter ID card, or an NREGA job card signed by a State Government officer. In addition, a PAN card (or Form 60 if no PAN) is mandatory. [KYC-004]

cases.question: How often does a low risk customer need to update their KYC?
cases.answer: Low‑risk customers must update their KYC every 10 years. [KYC-004]

cases.question: Within how many days will the bank give a shadow credit for an unauthorised transaction?
cases.answer: The bank will give a shadow credit within 10 working days of the complaint being reported. [DIS-005]

cases.question: When can I approach the RBI Ombudsman with a complaint?
cases.answer: You may approach the RBI Ombudsman if your complaint has not been resolved within 30 days of lodging it with Arya Bank, or if you are not satisfied with the bank’s response. This is the Level 3 escalation step in the grievance redressal process. [DIS-005]

cases.question: What timings is video KYC available?
cases.answer: Video KYC (V‑CIP) is available from 9 AM to 9 PM on all days except national holidays. [KYC-004]

cases.question: My credit card total amount due is ₹12,000 and I missed the minimum payment. What late fee will I be charged?

cases.question: I want a home loan of ₹50 lakh. What is the maximum percentage of the property value the bank will fund?

cases.question: I reported a fraudulent transaction on my savings account 5 working days after the bank's alert. What is my maximum liability?

cases.question: If I close my savings account 3 months after opening it, will I be charged?
